About Get Growing Marketing

We studied adventure tourism from the inside.

Get Growing Marketing was built by a team who ran the tours, crewed the boats, and spent years on Kauaʻi understanding exactly why people book and why they come back.

"I used to guide the tours. Now I tell their stories."

Three years. Three types of operations.

I'm Sareh Michelle, founder of Get Growing Marketing. In 2021 I sold my e-commerce business and moved to Kauaʻi. I wanted something the mainland couldn't give me; a slower pace, real community, and a life lived outdoors. I took almost every tour I could find on the island, before I started working them. Zipline. Kayak tours. Sailing catamaran snorkel trips and dinner cruises.

The whole time I was guiding, I was studying marketing. But guiding gave me something that no schooling could: three years of casually interviewing guests on every tour. How did you find us? What made you book? Season after season, that research lives in every piece of content Get Growing Marketing creates.

I kept seeing the same problem.

Generic agencies posting beautiful, but shallow content. No origin story or connection to your company beyond just another fun thing to do. My goal is to make your audience feel seen, inspired, curious, and connected.

Content without strategy is just noise.
Authenticity outperforms polish - every time.
The best marketing starts with understanding why people book.

About our services

Do I need to supply content or do you produce it?+

Both options are available. Our Reels to Reservations package works from your existing footage. Our Full Production Retainer includes on-island shooting by our team.

Which platforms are included?+

Common questions

About the process

How involved do I need to be during onboarding?+

About 60 - 90 minutes of your time for the onboarding call. After that we handle the research, strategy document, and content build - and present everything for your approval before anything goes live.

Can I approve content before it goes live?+

Yes - always. Full content calendar sent for your review every month. Nothing publishes without your sign-off.

Common questions

About pricing

Do I have to sign a long-term contract?+

No long-term contract required. Month-to-month pricing is available. Operators who commit to 6 months unlock a lower rate and consistently see stronger results.

What happens if we want to cancel?+

Month-to-month clients can cancel with 30 days written notice. 6-month clients who cancel early are responsible for remaining months at the standard rate.
